# Summary

Describe the change in a few sentences.

## User-Facing Outcome

What can someone using Atlas now see, trust, understand, or do that they could
not before?

## Checks

- [ ] I ran the relevant tests, linters, type checks, or docs validation.
- [ ] I updated generated files when API contracts or generated clients changed.
- [ ] I updated public docs, repo docs, or comments where behavior changed.
- [ ] I removed secrets, private data, and sensitive personal information from
      examples, logs, and fixtures.

## Source And Data Safety

If this changes records, discovery, search, confidence, corrections, exports, or
source evidence, explain how provenance is preserved and how users can inspect
the underlying public sources.
